cfallin opened PR #14677 from cfallin:fix-guest-debug-empty-func to bytecodealliance:main:

Some generated functions (e.g. a module start function) don't have any program points corresponding to a guest Wasm PC address. In this case, our fuzzy "last program point" match finds an unrelated program point in the previous function in the compiled text segment. We should instead return None in this case.

Fixes #14563.

:thumbs_up: alexcrichton submitted PR review:

The func_starts field probably ends up duplicating something within the other function indices we have in CompiledFunctionsTable, but it seems reasonable to me to add them into the debugging information as well as it's probably relatively pretty small and it's laid out slightly differently too based on runtime lookup requirements.
alexcrichton added PR #14677 Guest debugging: handle functions with no program points properly. to the merge queue

cfallin commented on PR #14677:

Yes, it's a bit hazy in memory now but there were a few differences wrt other tables (e.g. trap tables) that caused me to build a debug-specific set of tables initially. At some point I should go back and look at refactoring/sharing more representation...
